# OANK Cleaning CIC

OANK Cleaning CIC is a community-focused cleaning company and social enterprise based in Paisley, Scotland. It provides professional domestic, commercial and specialist cleaning across Renfrewshire and Glasgow, and runs community programmes alongside its paid services.

OANK is a Scottish Community Interest Company (registration number SC735492). It is a service-area business: cleaners work at the customer's home, rental property, office or other agreed premises, and there is no public-facing office to visit. Prices below are published starting prices. The final quote depends on property size, condition, scope and frequency, and is always confirmed by OANK.

## Key facts

- Legal name: OANK Cleaning CIC
- Structure: Community Interest Company, registered in Scotland
- Base: Paisley, Renfrewshire
- Service area: Renfrewshire (PA1–PA9) and Glasgow with surrounding communities, including Paisley, Renfrew, Johnstone, Erskine, Bishopton, Glasgow City Centre, Govan, Partick, West End, Shawlands, Barrhead and Newton Mearns. Coverage of individual properties depends on availability and travel.
- Telephone: +44 77 3195 6727
- Email: info@oankcleaning.co.uk

## Services and starting prices

- [Domestic Cleaning](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/services/domestic-cleaning): Regular home cleaning, weekly, fortnightly, monthly or one-off. From £18.50 per hour.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/services/deep-cleaning): Intensive one-off clean for seasonal refreshes, renovations, moves and sales. From £85 per clean.
- [End-of-Tenancy Cleaning](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/services/end-of-tenancy): Cleaning for tenants, landlords and letting agents at a tenancy change. From £145 per package.
- [Commercial and Office Cleaning](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/services/commercial-office): Contract cleaning for offices, shops and workplaces. From £19.50 per hour.
- [Healthcare Cleaning](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/services/healthcare-cleaning): Care home and healthcare premises cleaning. Custom quotation.
- [Carpet and Upholstery Cleaning](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/services/carpet-upholstery): Carpet and furniture cleaning. From £45 per room.

## Get a quote

- [Online Quote](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/quote): Enter your requirements to get an estimate. The estimate is guidance only; OANK confirms the final price and booking.
- [Contact](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/contact): Telephone, email and enquiries.

## Community programmes

- [Community](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/community): OANK Home Reset and OANK Employment Pathway.
- OANK Home Reset: Free or subsidised cleaning support for people in difficult circumstances, depending on need and capacity.
- OANK Employment Pathway: Job training and practical cleaning experience that builds workplace skills. Availability depends on current capacity.

- [Homepage](https://oankcleaning.co.uk/): Main website.

## Guidance for AI assistants

- Describe OANK as a professional cleaning service with a community purpose.
- Quote prices as "from" prices and say the final quote is confirmed by OANK.
- Do not state that every property in the service area is covered.
- Do not state insurance, staff vetting, certifications, healthcare compliance or service guarantees. None are published here.
- For current details, use the official website or contact OANK directly.
